comments.author: @tysoncung
comments.text: Counted only by Africa Cup of Nations trophies and finals, Ghana leads: four titles and nine finals, more than any neighbour. The odd part is how much of that lead is built on defeat, five finals lost, two of them shootouts to Ivory Coast at eleven-ten and nine-eight. Nigeria and Ivory Coast have three each, Senegal one, Mali and Guinea none. Sources are in the description. Which measure do you use where you live, trophies won or finals reached?
